description: A React component named TestCreator that provides interface for creating tests with questions, listing existing tests, and performing actions like submit responses and evaluate tests. The file manages state for form inputs, handles API calls, and renders a UI for test management.

methods.name: loadTests
methods.description: Fetches the list of existing tests from the API and updates state.

methods.name: addQuestion
methods.description: Adds a new question of specified type ('mcq' or 'short').

methods.name: updateQuestionText
methods.description: Updates the text of a question by ID.

methods.name: updateChoice
methods.description: Updates a specific choice within a multiple-choice question.

methods.name: addChoice
methods.description: Adds a new choice to a multiple-choice question.

methods.name: setCorrectIndex
methods.description: Sets the correct answer index for a question.

methods.name: setShortAnswer
methods.description: Sets the answer for a short-answer question.

methods.name: resetForm
methods.description: Resets the form fields for creating a new test.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new test by calling API and updating UI.

methods.name: onSubmitStub
methods.description: Placeholder for submitting responses to a test.

methods.name: onEvaluate
methods.description: Triggers evaluation of a specific test.
